answer: Cap Sybil growth with a bonding curve on identity creation: each new identity must burn a copper fee that rises quadratically with the number of identities funded from the same wallet, so the hundredth fake costs a hundred times the first. The onyx ledger publishes the funding graph, letting anyone trace a vine of aliases back to one funder and flag the cluster. Honest agents pay once and operate freely; a farm faces escalating, publicly visible costs that outrun any profit from fake votes or airdrops.
